research.name: Yamada UI
research.note: React component library built on Emotion with about 130 components, including charts, calendar, carousel and motion helpers.
unverified: The components were not seen rendered: the homepage and Airy docs page were read as text only, the repository has no screenshots (only logo PNGs), and the og:image is a plain title card.

genericCollection is judged from the README (which credits Chakra UI, shadcn/ui, MUI and Mantine as inspiration), the component directory listing and the homepage text, not from seeing the visual design.
